data_yaml:
seed: 29

dataset:
  root: /n/holylabs/qianqian_lab/Lab/mwakeham/visuotactile-objects/sam-3d-touch-data/objaverse-dexonomy
  manifest: generated_data/samples_full_surface.jsonl
  split_file: generated_data/splits.json
  split: train

touch:
  source: full_surface

runtime.precision: fp32 weights and outer computation; VecSetX attention internally casts Q/K/V to bf16

scope: Frozen representation reconstruction of recorded surfaces. Oracle inversion is privileged. Camera VecSetX skips isotropic SSI because it cancels under bbox/radius normalization; no image/pointmap conditioning. No training or Stage 2.

sam_latent_controls.scope: Scoring controls, not additional predictors or independent test objects.
